tasks.instruction_text: Open the Playtime filter on the Asgard's Wrath 2 reviews page and drag the minimum thumb to 'Over 100 hours' so I only see reviews from players with over 100 hours of playtime.
Set the Playtime filter to 'Over 10 hours' on the Asgard's Wrath 2 review page.
Browse Asgard's Wrath 2 reviews from players with between 50 and 200 hours on record. Drag the min thumb to 50 hours and the max thumb to 200 hours.
Pull up the latest negative reviews from players with over 100 hours of playtime for Asgard's Wrath 2 — set Playtime to 'Over 100 hours' and Review Type to Negative.
Set the Playtime filter to 'Over 100 hours' on the Asgard's Wrath 2 reviews page. How many of those reviewers gave a negative recommendation?
Among players with over 100 hours of playtime who left a negative review on Asgard's Wrath 2, which reviewer's comment got the most 'helpful' votes — and how many votes?

Filter the Asgard's Wrath 2 reviews to players with over 100 hours of playtime, and only show Not Recommended reviews. Drag the Playtime min thumb to 100 hours and check the Negative review-type filter.
Set the Playtime range from 1 to 10 hours so I only see Asgard's Wrath 2 reviews from short-session players — drag the min thumb to 1 hour and the max thumb to 10 hours.
Drag the Playtime minimum thumb up to 200 hours. How many Asgard's Wrath 2 reviews are from players with at least that much time on record?
Among the negative reviews from players with over 100 hours of playtime on Asgard's Wrath 2, who clocked the most hours and how many?
